description: Warps the frequency axis of the spectrum: every component above frq_divide is moved by a stretch factor that scales from 1 (no movement, at the divide) up to maxstretch at the top of the spectrum, with exponent shaping the curve between. Because the frequency RATIOS between partials are not preserved, a harmonic sound becomes inharmonic in a controllable way — stretching, as opposed to shifting, the spectrum (derived from CDP's former SPECE). Pinned to submode 1 (stretch above the frq_divide); submode 2 stretches below it instead. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: The classic route from harmonic to inharmonic: partials at 100/200/300/400 Hz become e.g. 110/213/316/419 — no common factor, so the sound acquires bell- or gong-like multiple pitches, or with small stretches just a strong spectral colouration. The manual's rubber-sheet image is apt: the whole spectrum above the divide is warped as one surface. frq_divide is the single most important parameter — place it where the sound's pitched anchor should stop being touched. maxstretch > 1 pushes the top upward (components stretched past Nyquist silently disappear, so extreme values thin the spectrum), while values < 1 bunch the highs downward and darken the tone. exponent < 1 makes the stretch rise quickly then even out; > 1 starts slowly and accelerates toward the top. depth is a true dry/wet for the warp and is the one time-varying parameter: a breakpoint ramp from 0 to 1 lets a sound slide from its harmonic self into its inharmonic double as it plays. Harmonic, clearly pitched sources (voice especially) reveal the process most plainly.

frq_divide.description: Frequency above which spectral stretching takes place. Enforced 5 Hz to the Nyquist frequency ('out of range (5.000000 to 22050.000000)' probed at -100 and 30000 on a 44.1 kHz analysis; source: lo = PITCHZERO (5.0), hi = nyquist, cdp2k/tklib1.c). Scalar only — a breakpoint file is refused ('brkpnt_files not permitted').

maxstretch.description: Transposition ratio of the topmost spectral component: > 1 stretches the top upward, < 1 compresses it downward (0.5 verified clean). The enforced bound is analysis-dependent: SPEC_MINFRQ/nyquist to nyquist/SPEC_MINFRQ with SPEC_MINFRQ = 10.0 (cdp2k/tklib1.c, speccon.h:29) — 0.000454 to 2205 on a 44.1 kHz analysis, from the refusal text at 0. Scalar only — a breakpoint file is refused.

exponent.description: Shape of the stretch curve across the spectrum: < 1 rises quickly then evens out, 1 is linear, > 1 starts slowly and rises faster toward the top. The banner only says '> 0'; enforced 0.02 to 50 from the refusal text at 0 (source: STR_MIN_EXP/STR_MAX_EXP, speccon.h:242-243). Scalar only — a breakpoint file is refused.

depth.description: Stretch effect on the source, 0 (no effect) to 1 (full effect) — a dry/wet control. Default 1.0 verified: flag-less and -d1 runs are bit-identical. May vary over time via a breakpoint file attached to the flag (-d<file>, verified with a 0 -> 1 ramp). A CONSTANT 0 is refused ('A non-varying depth value of zero will not change your source file.'), but 0 is legal inside a time-varying file.

examples.description: Moderate inharmonic warp above the pitch anchor.
examples.expected_use: Turn a harmonic source bell-like: keep everything below 1 kHz intact, stretch the top an octave out of tune with itself.

examples.description: Fade the warp in over the sound — supply depth as a breakpoint file (e.g. '0 0 / 2.0 1').
examples.expected_use: A sound that starts as itself and slides into its inharmonic double, the stretch arriving mostly in the highs.

known_issues: A constant depth of 0 is refused with the semantic error 'A non-varying depth value of zero will not change your source file.' (exit 255, INVALID DATA) even though 0 is inside the enforced 0-1 range — supply 0 only inside a breakpoint file (verified accepted).

The banner's 'exponent (> 0)' is enforced as 0.02-50, and maxstretch's real bound is the analysis-dependent 0.000454-2205 (nyquist/10 rule), not afta8's 0-100. SoundThread's 0.3-4 sliders for maxstretch/exponent are UI ceilings. afta8's depth default of 0.5 is a UI seed value — the true CDP default is 1.0 (full effect), verified bit-identical to a flag-less run.
Components stretched beyond the Nyquist frequency silently disappear (manual), so large maxstretch values progressively thin the top of the spectrum rather than adding range.
The manual lists SPECTSTR next to the STRETCH family, but that is a newer version of stretch time (time-stretching), unrelated to this frequency-domain warp.
